product_brief: ONTAP 9 is NetApp's data management software delivering storage, data protection, and security features across AFF, ASA, and FAS systems.
pqc_support: Yes — post-quantum algorithms for data-in-transit (ONTAP 9.18.1) and post-quantum pre-shared keys for IPsec (ONTAP 9.17.1)
pqc_capability_description: ONTAP 9.18.1 states "PQC support for data in transit" with "Ability to use post-quantum algorithms for data-in-transit." ONTAP 9.17.1 supports postquantum pre-shared keys for IPsec to protect against potential future quantum computer attacks. Specific PQC algorithms (e.g., ML-KEM) are not named.
crypto_primitives: TLS 1.3, TLS 1.2, IPsec, mTLS, SHA512 password hashing, SSH A512 password hashing, NetApp Volume Encryption (NVE)
key_management_model: Supports external key manager integration (OpenStack Barbican key manager for NetApp Volume Encryption keys)
architecture_type: Software-defined data storage and management platform
primary_platforms: NetApp AFF, ASA, FAS, AFX, and ASA r2 storage systems; Cloud Volumes ONTAP

evidence.PQC Support: PQC support for data in transit Ability to use post-quantum algorithms for data-in-transit.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: IPsec postquantum pre-shared key support ONTAP supports postquantum pre-shared keys for IPsec to protect against potential future quantum computer attacks.
evidence.Latest Version: ONTAP 9.18.1 delivers new and enhanced features in the areas of security, scalability, and storage management to support data infrastructure modernization.
evidence.Crypto Primitives: Support for SHA512 and SSH A512 password hashing protects administrator account credentials from malicious actors who are trying to gain system access.
